Name: Catalogue Indicator - Chest and Inventory
Author: ThePoganPl
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Adds icon to all decorations that are avalivable from any Catalogue. 
Made it so i could save some space in chests and to prevent trashing unique items[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Just drop it in your Mods folder[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]If you have original "Catalogue Indicator" mod by GrendG installed. Remove it first. 
This mod is an replacement, not addon. [/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Since i have no modding experience, this is an AI-assisted modification of "Catalogue Indicator" mod by GrendG
All credits for the mod goes to them. [/color]

Manifest.Name: Catalogue Indicator - Inventory
Manifest.Description: Adds the Catalogue Indicator icon to shop, player inventory, and chest inventory items.
